admission.justification: Immutable atomic creation prevents a resumed role reading an assignment silently rewritten under the original launch identity.

applicability: Creating the first-assignment artifact for a role launch.
exclusions: Lost-artifact reconstruction belongs to saved-message retry contract.
statement: Every launch stores the compiled first message once as a plain-text handover artifact `<report path without its suffix>.handover.txt` of at most 1,048,576 bytes, created read-only (mode 0444) by a hard link of a finished temporary file: an existing file is reused only when it holds the same bytes, different content is refused and nothing changes, and a link at the artifact's own name is never followed.
